Name: Enterprise Context
What happens: Organisation, business model, geography, scale, stakeholders, strategy, technology landscape.

Name: Problem Framing
What happens: What is happening, why, root cause, what if nothing changes, who owns it.

Name: Discovery and Diagnosis
Deliverable: Current-state, capability map, stakeholder map, process and value-stream, technology and data, maturity assessments

Name: 9P4V Assessment
What happens: Map the challenge across the nine pillars and find the current V1 to V4 position.

Name: Experience Discovery
What happens: Customer, employee, partner, manager, executive or citizen experience.
Deliverable: Experience Journey and Pain Point Map

Name: 12-Stream Architecture
What happens: Future-state architecture across the relevant streams.
Deliverable: Target architecture and one deliverable per stream

Name: Strategic Options
What happens: Three or four credible alternatives, each judged on fit, value, cost, risk, feasibility, experience, time, scalability.

Name: Trade-Offs
What happens: Explicit decisions: cost vs experience, speed vs quality, innovation vs risk, standardisation vs customisation, AI autonomy vs human control, short-term ROI vs long-term value, complexity vs flexibility.

Name: Decision Room
What happens: Simulate the executive boardroom (CEO, CFO, CIO, COO, CHRO, CISO, business leader, customer or employee representative, enterprise architect).

Name: Transformation Roadmap
What happens: Initiatives, dependencies, milestones, waves, resources, governance, change, risks, benefits.

Name: Transformation Shock
What happens: An unexpected disruption forces a revised plan.

Name: V3 Victory
What happens: Prove measurable progress: outcomes, adoption, benefits, KPIs, milestones, stakeholder confidence.

Name: V4 Venture
What happens: Make the transformation sustainable and scalable.
Deliverable: Venture and scale model, operating model, governance, replication playbook, sustainability model, innovation pipeline

Name: Reflection and Next Vision
What happens: What worked, failed, changed, was learned, should be re-architected, and what new opportunity emerged.
